title: Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love TV Anime Reveals New Visual, 4 More Cast Members
content:
Kadokawa revealed more cast and a new visual on Thursday for the television anime of Ayune Araragi 's Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love ( Isshiki-san wa Koi o Shiritai. ) manga.

The new cast includes:

Kazuya Komai (episode director for Tenjho Tenge , BECK: Mongolian Chop Squad , Pita-Ten ) is directing the anime at Sakura Create . Deko Akao ( Komi Can't Communicate , Noragami , The Case Study of Vanitas ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Shōhei Hamaguchi ( Glamorous Heroes ) is designing the characters.

• Prop Design: Noriyasu Murata

• CG Director: Satomi Nakajima

• CG Production: Studio Twinkle

• Color Key Artist: Akiko Saito

• Art Director: Yasutada Kato

• Compositing Director of Photography: Daisuke Horino

• Editing: Yūsuke Ueno

• Sound Director: Masanori Tsuchiya

• Music: MICHIRU

• Music Production: Kadokawa

The romantic comedy follows Isshiki Rinna Milford, an elite, straight-laced officer who joined the police at age 17 (but has not experienced romantic love), and Meishi Rokutanda, a kind but scatterbrained and incompetent detective. As two newbies at love, they become a couple (of sorts) as they find out about romance.

Araragi launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Monthly Shōnen Ace magazine in June 2020, and Kadokawa published the manga's 10th compiled volume on May 25.

Yen Press has licensed the manga for release in English, and will release the first volume on October 13. While Yen Press initially licensed the manga under the title Ms. Isshiki Wants to Know About Love , the company will now release the manga under the title Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love .
author: ANN

title: Shin Oishinbo TV Anime Reveals Main Cast & Staff Members, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for Shin Oishinbo (New Oishinbo), the new television anime series of storywriter Tetsu Kariya and artist Akira Hanasaki 's Oishinbo manga, opened on Thursday and revealed the anime's teaser visual, main cast and staff members, and its 2027 debut.

The anime will star:

Yōhei Azakami as Shirō Yamaoka

Hitomi Sasaki as Yūko Kurita

Akio Ōtsuka as Yūzan Kaibara

Ken'ichi Nishida ( Good Bye, Dragon Life , Papuwa , Poka Poka Mori no Rascal ) is directing the anime at Synergy SP and Vega Entertainment . Takahiro Nagano ( Reincarnated as a Sword two seasons, Plannosaurus Gachi Koseibutsu Bu ) is in charge of series scripts, and Nozomi Kawashige ( Good Bye, Dragon Life ) is designing the characters. Shinei Animation is in charge of production.

The duo originally launched the manga in 1983. Shogakukan published the 111th volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since 2014.

The manga depicts the "fierce food showdown" between the newspaper Tōzai Shimbun's "Ultimate Menu" and gourmand Yuzan Kaibara's "Supreme Menu."

A previous television anime adaptation from Shinei Animation aired for 136 episodes from 1988 to 1992. The anime also includes two additional specials.

Viz Media has published five volumes of Oishinbo on its VizManga.com digital manga service and Viz Manga App, and has also published the volumes in print.

The manga has also inspired several live-action series and a live-action film.

title: 'Bless' Unveils Additional Cast, Character Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga unveiled additional cast and the character promotional video on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on Fuji TV's NoitaminA programming block at 11.30. p.m. in January 2027.

Cast Ginga Yoyogi: Nobuhiko Okamoto ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Oroka Sumeragi: Yoshino Aoyama ( Bocchi the Rock! ) Shitataka Sumeragi: Momoka Terasawa ( Make Heroine ga Oosugiru! )

Shoutarou Kitamura ( Make Heroine ga Oosugiru! ) is directing the anime at A-1 Pictures , with Takayuki Kikuchi ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Ultra Romantic episode director) serving as assistant director. Kamiza Fukurou ( Non Non Biyori Nonstop ) is handling the series composition and script. Honoka Yokoyama ( [Oshi no Ko] 2nd Season ) is designing the characters. Ryo Yoshimata ( Koi wa Ameagari no You ni ) is composing the music.

Sonoyami began serializing the fashion drama manga in Shounen Magazine Edge in January 2022. It was transferred to Shounen Sirius in December 2023. Kodansha published the eighth volume on March 9, with the ninth volume scheduled for an October 8 release.

Kondasha USA licensed the manga for English release in July 2023. The series is simulpublished digitally through Kodansha's K Manga website and app. The seventh volume was released on February 10, with the eighth volume scheduled for an April 2027 release.

Bless ranked 11th in the print category for the 2023 Next Manga Awards .

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Anime Reveals Eight and Final Ending Featuring "LISTEN TO THE STEREO!!" by Going Under Ground
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its eight and final opening, featuring the song “LISTEN TO THE STEREO!!” by Going Under Ground. The song was used in Episodes 178-203, while the new video was released as part of the series’ 20th anniversary celebration.

The release follows yesterday’s release of the fourteenth ending, featuring the song “gr8 story” by SuG . The releases are part of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the latest entry below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: 'Isshiki-san wa Koi wo Shiritai.' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Ayune Araragi 's Isshiki-san wa Koi wo Shiritai. ( Ms. Isshiki Wants to Know About Love ) manga revealed additional cast and a key visual (pictured) on Thursday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.

Cast Iwata Danjuro: Haruki Ishiya ( Hibike! Euphonium ) Nakatani Masato: Takuma Nagatsuka ( SK∞ ) Matsumoto Chikai: Hiiro Ishibashi ( Kaoru Hana wa Rin to Saku ) Yamakawa Rena: Yuu Wakui ( Otonari ni Ginga )

Kazuya Komai ( A-Channel episode director) is helming the anime at Sakura Create , with Deko Akao ( Komi-san wa, Comyushou desu. ) handling the series composition. Shouhei Hamaguchi ( Glamorous Heroes ) is designing the characters. Michiru ( Given ) is composing the music.

Ayune originally serialized the romantic comedy manga titled Rinna Keibu wa Iki ga Dekinai in Comic REX magazine from October 2016 to December 2017 before relaunching it in Monthly Shounen Ace magazine in December 2020. Kadokawa published the tenth volume on May 25.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English on March 23 and published the first volume on September 22. The second volume is going on sale in January 2027.

title: 'Shin Oishinbo' Reveals Main Cast, Staff
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya 's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oshinbo , revealed the main cast, staff and a teaser visual on Thursday (pictured below). The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

Cast Shirou Yamaoka: Youhei Azakami ( Kamonohashi Ron no Kindan Suiri ) Yuuko Kurita: Hitomi Sasaki ( Black Clover ) Yuuzan Kaibara: Akio Ootsuka ( Fate/strange Fake )

Staff Director: Kenichi Nishida ( Naruto: Shippuuden ) Series Composition: Takahiro Nagano ( Tensei shitara Ken deshita ) Character Design: Nozomi Kawashige ( Deatte 5-byou de Battle Animation Production: SynergySP , Vega Entertainment Production: Shin-Ei Animation

Kariya began writing Oishinbo in Shogakukan's Big Comic Spirits magazine in 1983, featuring art by Akira Hanasaki . Shogakukan published the 111th and latest volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since May 2014.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English and published seven themed compilation volumes under its VIZ Signature imprint from January 2009 to January 2010.

Shin-Ei Animation produced a television anime based on the manga that ran for 136 episodes from October 1988 to March 1992.

title: Rudy Takes Action in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 14 Preview
content:
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 14 preview images and synopsis ahead of its September 27 premiere. The anime entered its darkest episodes yet with the introduction of future Rudeus and his diary , with the next episode expected to conclude the arc and show how current Rudy will move forward. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup . You can also see the preview images and synopsis for Episode 14 “Resolve” below.

After finishing Old Rudeus’s diary, Rudeus begins taking action to protect his beloved family and prevent the tragic future that awaits them. While keeping the existence of Old Rudeus and the details surrounding him hidden from Sylphiette and Roxy, he warns them that their family may be in danger. And then, there is also the matter of “Eris”…

ALSO READ: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Blu-ray Volume 2 Reveals Shirotaka Jacket Artwork Featuring Current and Future Rudeus

The main staff for the anime was previously announced and includes:

• Director: Ryosuke Shibuya

• Character Design: Sanae Shimada, Ryota Furukawa

• Music: Yoshiaki Fujisawa

• Studio: Studio Bind

You can also check out the teaser trailer for the ongoing arc below.

Season 3 began with Volume 14, for which Seven Seas describes the story: Nanahoshi, Rudeus, and the rest of their group take a trip to Perugius’s mysterious floating fortress, seeking adventure and a once-in-a-lifetime chance to learn new magic. What they find instead is disaster as one of their number is struck down by a deadly illness. How far will Rudeus go to save a dear friend’s life?

You can also see the key visual for the third season.

The anime is based on a light novel by Rifujin na Magonote with Shirotaka’s illustrations. Seven Seas is publishing the light novel in English. The series is also launching a game titled Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation – Chronicle of Echoes this year. It is a free-to-play game with in-app purchases developed by ASOBIMO.

title: Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly Anime Streams Main Trailer for 2nd Part
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Thursday the main promotional video for the second cours (quarter of a year) of Mahō no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ), the new magical girl television anime that it is presenting with Studio Pierrot . The video previews the new opening theme song "Swingin' Magic" by K-pop girl group ILLIT .

The anime's second part will debut on October 4 on Tokyo MX at 10:30 p.m. JST, and will also run on ABC TV, TV Aichi , BS NTV , and AT-X .

The anime stars:

• May Tachibana as Fū Nonoyama/Lilly Konpeto (idol form)

• Nao Ojika as Rui Nonoyama/Lulu Mashū (idol form)

• Hiroki Nanami as Uguisu

• Ai Kayano as Azuki

• Fūka Izumi as Tōko Kandachi

• Fū Hirohara as Sena Aozono

• Hikaru Yaotome as Miitaa

• Kōhei Amasaki as Shōta Seo

• Tatsumaru Tachibana as Hisashi Kadoya

• Tomokazu Sugita as Yasuo Kandachi

• Jun Kasama as Keiichi Nonoyama

• Megumi Ōhara as Shio Nonoyama

• Aya Endō as Matsuri Hinoura

Takako Ohta and Yū Mizushima , who voiced Yū Morisawa / Creamy Mami and Toshio Ohtomo respectively in the Magical Angel Creamy Mami anime franchise , also appear in the anime as guest cast members.

Previously announced new cast members for the second part include Miyari Nemoto as Asahi Araki, Yusuke Shirai as Mucchi, and Yūko Natsuyoshi as Shiromofu.

The idol unit Lulutto Lilly, which consists of the anime's main characters Lilly Konpeto (voiced by May Tachibana ) and Lulu Mashū (voiced by Nao Ojika ) will perform the new ending theme song "Dream a la Mode."

Shintarō Dōge ( Arknights: Perish in Frost assistant director, Pet episode director) is directing the anime at Studio Pierrot , and is credited for the original character designs. Yūko Kakihara ( Blue Box , 2022 & 2024 Urusei Yatsura ) is supervising and writing the series scripts. Namiko Tori ( Pokémon: Paldean Winds sub-character designer), Hirono Nishiki ( My Dress-Up Darling episode key animator), and Asami Sodeyama ( Witchy Precure! -MIRAI DAYS- ) are designing the characters.

The anime's first part premiered on April 5 on the Tokyo MX channel, and also runs on ABC TV, TV Aichi , BS NTV , and AT-X . The anime is running for two cours , with a break in between. The anime is available on streaming services such as Ani-One and Bahamut in Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan; Anime Generation and Man-ga (television broadcast) in Italy; Anime Box in Spain; and on various services in Taiwan. Tubi also streams the anime in the United States and Canada.

Bandai Namco Filmworks ' YouTube channel started streaming the anime's first two episodes on April 18, which has subtitles in 16 languages including English. The episodes are available in North America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, and in parts of Europe, Africa, and Asia. Bandai Namco Filmworks has continued streaming the anime's episodes, with the 12th episode posted on June 27, and now has subtitles in 26 languages. As of writing, the anime's full episodes are not available in Southeast Asia.

title: 'Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Main Promo
content:
The official website for the Japan and France co-produced original television anime Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar revealed additional cast, theme songs and the main promotional video on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on October 2 at 9:25 p.m. on Tokyo MX.

Cast Zabel: Yuuko Kaida ( Gintama° ) Joris: Makoto Furukawa ( Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken ) Bechamel: Risa Kageyama ( Black Clover )

Japanese musical artist Hironobu Kageyama ( One Punch Man 3 ) and J-pop singer Masami Okui ( Haite Kudasai, Takamine-san ) are performing the opening theme "Bokura no Mirai e". Hironobu Kageyama is performing the ending theme "Omelet." The opening theme is previewed in the main promotional video below.

title: Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar Anime's Main Trailer Reveals More Cast Members, Theme Song Artists
content:
The official website for Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar ), the original television anime by French entertainment company Ankama , revealed the anime's main promotional video, new cast members, and theme song artists on Thursday.

The newly announced cast members are:

Yūko Kaida as Zabel, the powerful queen of Bonta

Makoto Furukawa as Joris, Welsh's guide and teacher, and a hero who once solved a major conflict that determined the country's fate

Risa Kayama as Bechamel, Welsh's childhood friend

Additional cast members include Wataru Takagi as Khan Karkass, and Show Hayami as Azalar.

The above video previews the anime's theme song "Bokura no Mirai e" (To Our Future) by artists Hironobu Kageyama and Masami Okui . Kageyama will also perform the ending theme song "Omelette." Kageyama & KUKO will perform the insert song "I'm in you."

The anime's staff also announced that Takuya Imakado ( The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash ) is the series' monster designer.

The anime will premiere on October 2 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST (8:25 a.m. EDT).

The anime will star Rikuya Yasuda as Welsh, and Yūki Kaji as Shedar.

Naoki Horiuchi (episode director for Kingdom second season, Black Clover , Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- ) is directing the anime at Studio Massket . Saori Nakashiki ( Sasaki and Peeps , Tales of Wedding Rings ) is designing the characters, and Nakashiki is also one of the chief animation directors alongside Yoshiaki Tsubata ( Date A Live IV ) and Yuki Ikeda ( WAVE!! -Let's go surfing!! movie trilogy).

Eri Suzuki ( Black Summoner ) is the color key artist, and Studio Massket is also in charge of anime background art. Lucas Cisterne (3D CG for The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash ) is in charge of art setting, Jun Watanabe ( Ascendance of a Bookworm ) is directing the sound at TO Books , and Pierre-Jean Beaudoin & Jose Pavli are composing the music. Tot is credited for the original work, scripts, and drafting the series story outline. Kenichi Yamashita ( MF Ghost ) is in charge of the series scripts for the anime's Japanese version.

Ankama is an independent entertainment and digital creation group most widely known for the DOFUS tactical MMORPG, which launched in 2004. The company also published Atsushi Kaneko 's SOIL manga , and Suguro Chayamachi 's Togainu no Chi manga in French.
